description: Unofficial Two fan-art animated companion inspired by Battle for Dream Island / TPOT. This independently drawn smooth-surface adaptation keeps a readable green numeral and two arms and legs. Original actions include paper-dot handling, arranging and straightening four foam blocks, a cushion crouch-rise, a short hop and separately drawn rightward, leftward and toward-camera steps. Soft paper and foam props replace real objects; merchandise fabric and seams are omitted. Not an official or endorsed product.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
